name: evidence.coverage
title: Show evidence coverage
summary: Coverage of a selection per level: how many have no children and, for requirements, no evidence, then how many have them; with the element lists.

selection.description: The elements to cover, as `element.list` takes them; every part given must hold (SR-101 AK2). Its view (else the view of its saved filter, else the core, SR-036 AK5) narrows the counted elements and their children to those it holds (SR-043: no core requirement the variant excludes or replaces), and evidence records count for that view, as the filter condition `verification` does.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: One level per element type of the selection with the meaning `need` or `requirement` (a subtype is its own level), in metamodel order (spec question ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#527). Elements whose status the metamodel marks invalid are not counted (SR-036 AK4, D-044); other types have no level. Per level the numbers without children and without evidence come before those with (SR-036 AK6), in this order of the properties.

total.title: Total
total.description: The counted elements of the type.

withoutChildren.title: Without children
withoutChildren.description: How many have no derivation child that counts, 0 included (SR-036 AK6).

withoutEvidence.title: Without evidence
withoutEvidence.description: Only for a type with the meaning `requirement`: how many have no verification record in the view, 0 included (SR-036 AK6).

withChildren.title: With children
withChildren.description: How many have a derivation child that counts: one whose status is not marked invalid and, with a view, that applies in it; in any repository.

withEvidence.title: With evidence
withEvidence.description: Only for a type with the meaning `requirement`: how many have at least one verification record in the view (the core without one), of any version and result (`hasVerificationRecord`, spec question ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#527).

elements.title: Elements per number
elements.description: The UUIDs behind every number, in selection order (SR-036 AK2): pass them as `selection.ids` to `element.list`. `withoutEvidence` and `withEvidence` only where the level has `withEvidence`.

names.title: Named elements
names.description: Every element of `levels[].elements`, each once in selection order, so a reader names them by short ID, identifier and title (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#588). Left out when no level lists an element.
